markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders view the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination as wide open, with Gavin Newsom, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Jon Ossoff clustered at the top of the field due to their established national profiles, fundraising networks, and institutional roles after the 2024 cycle. Newsom’s position draws from his California governorship and visibility on policy issues, Ocasio-Cortez from progressive grassroots support, and Ossoff from Senate service in a competitive state. Kamala Harris retains backing tied to her recent presidential run, while the broader distribution across dozens of names reflects fragmented early positioning, limited formal polling, and uncertainty over primary timing and voter coalitions. Scheduled midterms, potential candidate declarations, and shifts in party messaging could widen gaps among the leaders.
